title: UX Design Internship - Summer 2027
note: For junior-status bachelor's students in UX, experiential design, human factors or related fields; housing provided for out-of-town interns.

facts.duties: Work on UX projects for Uline's eCommerce sites: competitive and market analysis, stakeholder interviews, prototypes and concepts with business analysts.

facts.apply: Apply Now on uline.jobs (Workday), job ID R268775. Re-posted requisition; an earlier listing of this internship is closed on the board.
